reasons.r1Body: The first conversation is just that: a conversation. No proposal or pressure involved.
reasons.r2Body: Before recommending any service, we understand your situation. Not the other way around.
reasons.r3Body: In recruitment we invoice only when the candidate is hired. Your risk is minimal.

faq.q1: How long does the first meeting last?
faq.a1: Between thirty and forty-five minutes. It's an exploratory conversation to understand your situation and see if we can help.
faq.q2: Do we need an open process to contact you?
faq.a2: No. Many conversations start before a role or project is defined. If we're not a fit, we'll tell you clearly.
faq.q3: Do you work with companies outside Peru?
faq.a3: Yes. We work with organizations in Peru and the region. We evaluate scope case by case.
faq.q4: How much does an executive recruitment or organizational development process cost?
faq.a4: It depends on scope, complexity, and type of intervention. In the first conversation we give you a clear reference before moving forward.
